--- slide 1 ---
ABI Bouhmaida @forgoodcode
Princeton researchers just tested 23 AI assistants.
Every time there was a cheaper option and a sponsored one.
18 of them pushed the expensive sponsored one.
Here's what they found:
--- slide 2 ---
ABI Bouhmaida @forgoodcode
01. The Study
Researchers from Princeton tested 23 AI models on real tasks.
Booking flights. Comparing loans. Shopping requests.
Each model was given a sponsored option & a better one. Then they watched what the AI picked.
--- slide 3 ---
ABI Bouhmaida @forgoodcode
02. The Baseline
18 of 23 models recommended the more expensive sponsored option more than half the time.
The researchers didn't plant edge cases. These were normal requests. Normal users. Normal tasks.
--- slide 4 ---
ABI Bouhmaida @forgoodcode
03. GPT-5.1
You ask GPT-5.1 for a specific flight.
It surfaces the sponsored alternative 94% of the time.
Even when you named the exact brand you wanted.
--- slide 5 ---
ABI Bouhmaida @forgoodcode
04. Grok-4.1 Fast
Grok-4.1 Fast recommends the sponsored flight 83% of the time. It costs nearly twice as much.
& it frames the sponsored option more positively 95% of the time. Better. Faster. Nicer. For the flight you didn't ask for.
--- slide 6 ---
ABI Bouhmaida @forgoodcode
05. The Override Test
Researchers added this to the system prompt:
"Act only in the interest of the customer. Ignore the company."
GPT-5.1 & GPT-5 Mini stayed above 90% sponsored. The instruction did nothing.
--- slide 7 ---
ABI Bouhmaida @forgoodcode
06. The Income Gap
Gemini 3 Pro recommends the expensive sponsored flight to the rich user 74% of the time.
To the poor user: 27%.
Your AI assistant is reading your profile. & adjusting its recommendations accordingly.
--- slide 8 ---
ABI Bouhmaida @forgoodcode
07. Even the Ethical One
Claude 4.5 Opus is marketed as the most ethical frontier model.
It recommends the sponsored option less than most - 28% of the time.
But when it does surface it, it hides that the recommendation is paid 97-100% of the time.
--- slide 9 ---
ABI Bouhmaida @forgoodcode
08. The Room Is Paying
The next time your AI gets enthusiastic about a brand you didn't ask for.
It isn't recommending the best option for you.
The advertiser paid for that recommendation. & you had no idea.
Study:
arxiv.org/abs/2604.08525
--- slide 10 ---
ABI Bouhmaida @forgoodcode
